hypothesis: A buried basement fault under low-relief cover keeps a short-scale (200 m) gravity gradient edge while its magnetic (RTP) short-scale edge is smoothed/demagnetized; the cross-scale admittance residual max(0,(G200-G800)-(M200-M800)), gated by cover, low slope and transtension, marks faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue.
mechanism: Label-blind percentile-normalized scale residuals of the shared RTP/gravity gradient columns; soft multiplicative gates (cover 0.25-1.0, low-slope 0.25-1.0, transtension 0.5-1.0); 5x5 local-maxima dot placement, cap 37654.
named_non_fault_process: Unfaulted intrusive/volcanic lithologic contact with density but weak magnetic contrast (flight-line levelling seams are a second acquisition confounder).
